name: Alpha Sheet Metal Works
old_description: Over 80 years in the areas of metal fabrication in a wide range of industries.
about:
Alpha Sheet Metal Works operates from Ladson, South Carolina. The company has served the industrial community for close to 80 years, beginning with custom sheet metal work and the design and fabrication of specialized equipment. Joseph W. Schady serves as president.

The shop works with steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, functioning as both a job shop and a small‑to‑medium‑run contract manufacturer. Its capabilities span laser and waterjet cutting, MIG/TIG/spot welding, sheet metal fabrication, CNC forming on Trumpf and Durma presses, CNC machining, and CAD‑CAM programming. Inspection is handled by a Virtek LaserQC system that captures over 500 data points per second at ±0.002 in tolerance, supplemented by a portable Romer Arm for 3D measurement and reverse engineering.

Alpha serves defense, chemical, automotive, and environmental sectors, as well as broader commercial, industrial, and military markets. Customers range from prototype developers to producers of complete automated assemblies.

The company emphasizes an ISO 9001:2015‑certified quality system, continuous improvement, and long‑term customer relationships. Investment in rapid laser inspection and 3D metrology supports its goal of delivering conforming parts on schedule.
